independentDerivation.b: g(x)=5 sqrt(4-2(x+3))-1=5 sqrt(-2x-2)-1. The radicand requires -2x-2 >= 0, hence x <= -1, including the endpoint.
independentDerivation.c: The square root attains every value from 0 upward over that domain. Multiplying by positive 5 and subtracting 1 gives every y >= -1, including -1.
